## English

Plot the kill rate on a shared kills/h axis, and fix the panel startup log line.

- The trend chart now plots the recent kill rate and the rolling one-hour kill
  count on a shared "kills/h" axis (drawn on the right), so both can be read
  against the same scale.
- Fixed the panel startup log line.

## 中文

击杀率改用共享的「杀/时」坐标轴，并修好面板启动日志行。

- 趋势图把近期击杀率与滚动 1 小时击杀数画在同一条「杀/时」轴上（轴在右侧），两者可在同一刻度下对照。
- 修复了面板启动时的日志行。
